# 有限视界：任何有限的历史都不决定一段汲取是更新还是消耗 / Finite horizon: no finite history decides whether drawing renews or consumes

## 主张 Claim

在 Becoming.Renewal 的可更新条件的过程中，对每个视界 h，有两次运行在 h 之前的配置与动作都相同：焦点形成每一步都汲取两个单位（每步更新一个），而它的每个事件都在更新之内。此后一次在更新之内汲取，焦点形成在运行中是更新的；另一次继续超出，焦点形成是消耗的。因此，任何由前 h 步的配置与动作决定、并记入每次更新运行的读法，必记入某次消耗运行。分类不仅不是初始配置的函数，也不是任何有限前缀的函数。有反馈时也如此：在支持门控定律中，同一起点、h 之前每步汲取两个单位，在 h 停止则更新，继续则消耗；停止的一次从不到达支持阈值。这一结论的力量来自“记入每次更新运行”：那次更新运行在 h 之前每步都超出更新地汲取，整段读法记入这些事件；按数量的读法（该步所取不超过更新）由有限前缀决定，扣下两次运行在 h 之前的每个事件，只是不记入每次整段更新的运行。形成层面的周期读法不由任何有限前缀决定。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。推论（P49，Becoming.Testing）：没有由前 h 步决定的读法恰是整段的分类（Renewable.no_exact_finite_reading）；不认可任何消耗的运行的这种读法，不认可某个更新的运行（Renewable.finite_reading_withholds_renewal）。 / In the renewable process of Becoming.Renewal, for every horizon h there are two runs whose configurations and actions agree before h: the focal formation draws two units at every step (one is renewed each step), and each of its events is within renewal. Afterwards one run draws within renewal and the focal formation renews in it; the other keeps exceeding and the focal formation consumes. Hence any reading fixed by the configurations and actions of the first h steps that credits every renewing run credits some consuming run. The classification is a function neither of the initial configuration nor of any finite prefix. The same holds with feedback: in the support-gated law, from one start and drawing two units at every step before h, stopping at h renews and continuing consumes; the stopping schedule never reaches the support threshold. The force of the conclusion lies in “credits every renewing run”: that renewing run draws beyond renewal at every step before h, and the whole-run reading credits those events; an amount reading (taking no more than is renewed at the step) is fixed by finite prefixes and withholds every event before h in both runs, failing only to credit every whole-run-renewing run. The formation-level cycle reading is fixed by no finite prefix. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. Corollaries (P49, Becoming.Testing): no reading decided by the first h steps is the whole-run classification (Renewable.no_exact_finite_reading); such a reading crediting no consuming run withholds credit from some renewing run (Renewable.finite_reading_withholds_renewal).

Canonical source: [Horizon.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Horizon.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 可更新条件的过程没有反馈：水平按汲取与更新逐步变化，起点可以任意高。有反馈的情形在支持门控定律中另证：起点 h + 1，每步更新一个，维持者所需为 1，焦点形成所需为 0，没有贡献。 / The renewable process has no feedback: the level changes by drawing and renewal at each step, and the starting level can be arbitrarily high. The case with feedback is proved separately in the support-gated law: start h + 1, one unit renewed per step, sustaining need 1, focal need 0, no contribution.
- 那次更新运行在 h 之前每步都超出更新地汲取（每步两个单位，更新一个），由足够高的起点吸收；所以“记入每次更新运行”包括记入超出更新的汲取（第二次独立审查 F2）。 / The renewing run draws beyond renewal at every step before h (two units, one renewed), absorbed by a high enough start; so “credits every renewing run” includes crediting drawing beyond renewal (second independent review F2).
- “读法”是运行上的任意命题；结论只要求它由前 h 步决定并记入每次更新运行。 / A “reading” is any proposition on runs; the conclusion requires only that it be fixed by the first h steps and credit every renewing run.

这是一个存在性结果：一个过程就足以说明有限前缀一般地不决定分类。在有反馈的支持门控定律中，越过阈值之后损失不会回来，但阈值之前的前缀仍可与及时停止的运行相同（Feedback.prefix_does_not_decide）。给定动作，这些见证的动力学是确定的；有限前缀不决定的是此后的动作，所以对继续的探究部分地是对将要做什么的审议（论证，未形式化）。结论是否与 Ren 所采纳的问题冲突，取决于对这一问题的判决是否覆盖越过阈值之前的事件（诠释，Ren 的原话未定），以及可观测量是否带数量。实际历史的视界与此的对应，是经验问题。 / This is an existence result: one process suffices to show that a finite prefix does not in general decide the classification. In the support-gated law, which has feedback, a loss past the threshold does not return, yet a prefix before the threshold can still match a run that stops in time (Feedback.prefix_does_not_decide). Given the moves, the dynamics of these witnesses are deterministic; what no finite prefix decides is the moves to come, so inquiry into continuation is partly deliberation about what will be done (an argument, not formalized). Whether the conclusion conflicts with the problem Ren adopted depends on whether a verdict on that problem covers events before the threshold (interpretive; Ren's words leave it open) and on whether observables carry amounts. The correspondence to the horizons of actual histories is an empirical question.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

给依存网加数量与更新率，检验可由有限历史判定的读法能否满足 Ren 所采纳的问题与 Ren 所述的不重叠，或证明每个这样的读法在某个有来源的情形中不满足；说明对继续的探究与审议怎样给出“这段汲取是消耗”的判断，并与 L2 的所见范围接通。 / Give webs of dependence amounts and renewal rates, and test whether a reading decidable from a finite history can meet the problem Ren adopted and the non-overlap Ren states, or prove that every such reading fails it in a sourced case; explain how inquiry into continuation, and deliberation, yield the judgment that a stretch of drawing consumes, connecting it to L2's visible scope.
